note: Primary fixture alias for #92716. SubagentStop does not fire when a background subagent is killed via TaskStop or by Exit and stop tasks. Faceplate: unrung.
title: SubagentStop does not fire when a background subagent is killed via TaskStop or by "Exit and stop tasks"
surface: Claude Code SubagentStop hook on TaskStop / Exit-and-stop kill
expected: Every SubagentStart is followed by exactly one SubagentStop, regardless of how the subagent ends. A kill through TaskStop or session exit should fire the hook, with last_assistant_message empty if there is none.
actual: TaskStop and Exit-and-stop clear the agent from the task registry and never fire SubagentStop; --debug-file has no SubagentStop line for the killed agent; normal completion still fires SubagentStop with last_assistant_message
impact: hooks pairing SubagentStart/SubagentStop drift after every kill; background_tasks on Stop is not a substitute for the per-agent stop event
